decision_semantics.accept: Accept saved critic resale only, as an estimate with corrected buyback classification.
decision_semantics.correct: Use explicitly corrected resale/identity conclusion, subject to parent checks.
decision_semantics.hold: Do not apply proposed price/margin change. Numeric resale retains baseline resale_target_a1 only; it is not validated market evidence. Identity holds require manual review.

summary.evidence_status: No completed local mint sales or condition-specific buyback payouts were verified. All numerical resale recommendations are estimates from saved asking-price evidence; do not write them as observed sale prices or upgrade calibration_status to verified.
summary.buyback_status: All 48 buyback_market values are null. 38 raw headline ceilings are recorded separately. Ceiling spread, even above resale, does not prove a quote fake and never warrants raising resale.
summary.source_provenance: Saved files contain narrative aggregates, not raw listing records/ad IDs. OLX query URLs and normalized Cashify URLs are source-location pointers reconstructed from those notes; they are not claimed as fetched ad-level evidence. Model homepages with no deep link identify only the reported provider. Original critic sample counts were reviewed, not independently reproduced.

parent_controls: Preserve every existing authoritative net_new_inr; this artifact makes no new-price edits, including rows whose saved critic recommended overwriting it.
